data.name: Havilah
data.gender_notes: Havilah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In the Bible, Havilah is the name of a region located at the eastern end of the land of Canaan, known for its abundance of precious stones. Genesis 2:11-14 says: 'The name of the first [river] is the Pishon; it winds through the entire land of Havilah, where there is gold. And the gold from that land is good; bdellium and onyx stone are there. The name of the second river is the Gihon; it winds around the entire land of Canaan.', indicating Havilah as a prosperous and fertile land.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's provision and abundance in our lives.
data.etymology: Havilah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “The land of rest.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Havilah total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_greek.name: Χαβηλα
in_greek.meaning: αποτέλεσμα της γης από τα πέντε ορόσημα της
in_greek.long_meaning: Χαβηλα είναι μια περιοχή στην Αφρική που αναφέρεται στο Βιβλίο της Γένεσης. Αποτελεί μέρος του κλασικού ορόσημου των πέντε περιοχών της Γης που αναφέρονται στο Βιβλίο της Γένεσης. Η περιοχή του Χάβηλα αναφέρεται ως μια περιοχή με τεράστιες πλούσια πηγές και πλούσια φυτική ζωή. Είναι μια από τις πιο σημαντικές περιοχές στην Αφρική. Το όνομα Χάβηλα έχει χρησιμοποιηθεί σε διάφορες θρησκευτικές και πολιτιστικές εκφάνσεις.

in_latin.name: Havilah
in_latin.meaning: locus terrae ab quinque signis terrae
in_latin.long_meaning: Havilah est locus terrae qui in libro Genesis quinque signa terrae nominantur. Est pars classica orosigni terrae quae in libro Genesis nominantur. Havilah locus est opulentia fontium et luxuriantia vegetatio. Est locus importantissimus in Africa. Nomen Havilah in religiosis culturisque diversis usus est.

in_english.name: Havilah
in_english.meaning: a location on earth from the five marks of the earth
in_english.long_meaning: Havilah is a location on earth that is mentioned in the book of Genesis as one of the five marks of the earth. It is a place of great wealth and lush vegetation. The name Havilah has been used in various religious and cultural contexts. In Christianity, Havilah is associated with the Garden of Eden and the concept of paradise. It is also associated with the idea of a place of abundance and fertility.

data.cultural_impact: In ancient times, the name Havilah was associated with prosperity and wealth, as it was known for its abundance of precious stones.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, Havilah may represent the blessings that come from God's divine providence, emphasizing the abundant grace and riches found in His presence.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Havilah, in the Book of Genesis, is mentioned as a place of abundance, located east of Eden, where Cain settled after being banished. Its name is derived from the Hebrew word 'havil', meaning 'ruin' or 'desolation', yet it is also associated with richness and prosperity, symbolizing the potential for redemption and growth amidst hardships.

biblical_reference.note: Havilah is mentioned in the book of Genesis as a place of great wealth and lush vegetation.

historical_references.reference: According to the Book of Genesis, Havilah was a place of great abundance in biblical times, known for its precious stones, gold, and aromatical resin, 'balm of Gilead'. It is believed to be located in the eastern part of the land of Eden, in the area of modern-day Iraq and Saudi Arabia.

During the Crusades, the term 'Havilah' was used to refer to a region in the eastern Mediterranean, encompassing parts of modern-day Syria, Lebanon, and Israel. The name came from Havilah, the son of Canaan and grandson of Noah, according to the Bible.
